title: The Second Witness
premise: Two old friends go looking for a brief change in the night sky. One is an astronomer. The other belongs to the house that paid for the observatory.
authorship_notes: Develop an original project from the supplied night-sky encounter.
Make the central friends an astronomer and an aristocrat.
The title, characters, story and directing choices are proposed.
creative_intent: Begin with the Count sure of where authority sits. Make him wait for a voice from beyond the observatory, then let him ask that voice to show him where to look.
dramatic_question: When the valley station makes the observation possible, whose name will Adrian put on the record?
goal: Give his family the first announcement while securing an observation he can stand behind.
stakes: Adrian has promised the trustees an exclusive announcement before they vote on the observatory’s funding. Elias needs an independent record and credit for the observer who made it.
constraints: Keep both on-screen roles in one practical location.
Plan up to 15 seconds per generated segment including handles.
Keep the displayed science evidence at the level of a shared observation.
assumptions: English dialogue in an invented present-day setting with a landed house.
Two on-screen performers and a third character heard over the radio.
One hilltop terrace, one night, 16:9, 5:20 target including eight seconds for credits.
The observation and equipment readout are fictional. The joint log confirms a shared dip and leaves its cause open.
open_questions: Approve the title, the degree of period styling and the last held sky image.
Record a timed read for all three voices before locking the editorial clock.

scenes.heading: EXT. RADIO END OF THE BENCH – NIGHT
scenes.purpose: Turn the distant light into an observer with her own terms.
scenes.action_summary: Adrian keys the direct line. Nera replies and agrees to record if the school is named. Elias sends the field and tells her they will compare afterward.

scenes.heading: EXT. TELESCOPE BAY – NIGHT
scenes.purpose: Let the audience see the test and feel the wait for a second answer.
scenes.action_summary: The left point dims and returns. The right point holds. Elias marks his own log. He asks Nera to read hers first, and she reports the same pattern.

exit_state.summary: Target restored. Hill slip marked. Nera has reported one dip and a steady reference.

scenes.heading: EXT. RADIO END OF THE BENCH – NIGHT
scenes.purpose: Make the change in Adrian’s position visible in the paper and audible on the open line.
scenes.action_summary: He asks for Nera’s full name, alters the notice, moves the selector to OPEN and names both observers. Elias commits to release the paired logs.

scenes.heading: EXT. NORTH RAIL – NIGHT
scenes.purpose: Leave the two men with a new way to stand together and a person they are prepared to listen to.
scenes.location: LOC-001 · North rail and open sky
scenes.action_summary: Adrian asks Nera for a place to start. He and Elias go to the rail and look above the same roof light. The frame gives them and the ridge time to hold.
scenes.emotion_out: Wonder with room for someone else

continuity.screen_direction: Keep the ridge ahead. Elias left and Adrian right at the rail.

sound_requirements: Nera’s last instruction comes from the bench, behind them as they move.
Let wind and the unbroken night bed carry the last held image.
